title: Why "Survival" is VITAL to your business deal
description:
Ever heard of the “survival” clause in a contract? It might sound harmless, but it can have major consequences after the deal closes. In this video, we break down what contract survival terms really mean, why they matter in business acquisitions, and how they can leave you exposed long after you think the deal is done. Spoiler: some obligations don’t just disappear when the ink dries.

We’ll explain which reps, warranties, and indemnities typically survive closing, how long they last, and what protections you should negotiate into your agreement. Whether you're buying or selling a business, understanding survival clauses is key to avoiding surprises and staying protected. Don’t overlook this one—it’s more important than most people realize.
